Pre-existing vendor bug in go-cli-server (findAllDescendants) plus Slice B orphan_pgid missing build tag block full Windows cross-compile of daemon; platform package builds and tests compile cleanly for windows/amd64. Windows runtime validation pending — tested via cross-compile only.

Added //go:build unix to daemon_orphan_pgid.go and created daemon_orphan_pgid_stub_windows.go no-op stub. Linux daemon tests pass (including TestStartupOrphanPGIDScan_* trio), -race clean, gofmt clean, go vet clean. Full Windows cross-compile still blocked by pre-existing vendor bug in go-cli-server v0.3.8 (lifecycle.go references findAllDescendants which is only defined in lifecycle_unix.go) — out of scope for this tiny fix; needs separate go-cli-server release.
